name: status_extra
description: Extra statuses of one hit (the 16 bits of the extra word): the shatter roll of a Petrified target, Distill exclusivity, Doom, Eject, Auto-Life with Magic Booster, immunity, cleansing; and the stage buffs.

harness.note: the real machine code of the functions, only the RNG function replaced by a script; rngDraws is what the game asked for

notes: Class stage: stacks, mask (Cmd+0x56) and amount (Cmd+0x59) in; the six stacks out.
Arrays are sparse {"index": value} (missing = 0); applied/removed are the two result-counter arrays, in is their value before the call.
